tools.name: apply_view_template
tools.description: Applies a view template to many views chosen by name, id or view type in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only previews before/after templates.

tools.name: audit_template
tools.description: Audits the open project or template against the office checklist (browser, levels, phases, view templates, filters, views, line styles, annotation types, families, parameters, materials, schedules, sheets, export settings, naming) and previews purgeable items.

tools.name: bulk_set_parameters
tools.description: Sets parameter values on many elements in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: check_render_materials
tools.description: Checks render materials before exporting to Lumion: name pattern, duplicate names, generic materials shared by families, single-material furniture and geometry left with the category material.

tools.name: check_sheets
tools.description: Checks each sheet against the checklist of its sheet type before issuing (views, schedules, legends, scales, title block fields, revision) plus empty viewports and views off sheets.

tools.name: clear_colors
tools.description: Removes view color overrides from elements in a category.

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Closes the active Revit document, optionally saving changes.

tools.name: color_splash
tools.description: Applies view color overrides to elements grouped by a parameter value.

tools.name: create_rooms
tools.description: Creates rooms at points or inside new room separation polygons (meters), with name, number and tags, and reports areas in m²; all or nothing after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: create_sheets
tools.description: Creates many sheets with a chosen or default title block in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: create_walls
tools.description: Creates straight walls from start/end points in meters on a level, with type, height or top level, in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: execute_revit_code
tools.description: Executes supplied IronPython code in Revit with the Windows user's permissions after review in Revit; code can access model data, files and network services.

tools.name: export_rooms
tools.description: Lists rooms with number, name, level, area, perimeter, volume and placement status, as JSON or CSV.

tools.name: export_schedule
tools.description: Reads a schedule's rows as JSON or CSV text.

tools.name: export_sheets_pdf
tools.description: Exports sheets (by number, sheet set or all) to PDF with Revit's native exporter, named by the office rule (project, sheet, revision, date), with an emissao.json issue manifest; replaces existing files only with a backup; dry run by default.

tools.name: get_current_view_elements
tools.description: Lists elements visible in the active view, with optional level and location information.

tools.name: get_current_view_info
tools.description: Reads the active view's properties and settings.

tools.name: get_element_parameters
tools.description: Reads instance and optionally type parameters of elements, with raw and display values and editability.

tools.name: get_revit_model_info
tools.description: Reads project metadata, element counts, rooms, views, sheets, warnings and linked-model information.

tools.name: get_revit_status
tools.description: Reads bridge health and active document availability.

tools.name: get_revit_view
tools.description: Exports a named model view as a PNG image.

tools.name: get_selected_elements
tools.description: Lists the elements currently selected by the user, with category, family, type and level.

tools.name: launch_revit
tools.description: Starts an installed Revit version, optionally opens a model file, and checks bridge readiness.

tools.name: list_category_parameters
tools.description: Lists element parameters and sample values for a category.

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: Lists loaded family types with optional name filtering.

tools.name: list_family_categories
tools.description: Lists categories of loaded families.

tools.name: list_levels
tools.description: Lists model levels and their elevations.

tools.name: list_revit_installations
tools.description: Lists installed Revit versions and their executable locations.

tools.name: list_revit_views
tools.description: Lists exportable model views grouped by view type.

tools.name: model_health_report
tools.description: Reads model health indicators: grouped warnings, imported CAD, in-place families, views off sheets, unused templates, links, groups and file size.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Opens a specified Revit document, optionally auditing or detaching it from central.

tools.name: phases_report
tools.description: Reads project phases, phase filters, element counts per created/demolished phase and views per phase.

tools.name: place_family
tools.description: Places a loaded family instance at specified coordinates and sets requested properties.

tools.name: place_hosted_families
tools.description: Places doors, windows or other wall-hosted families in walls by wall id and offset or nearest point (meters), with sill height and flips; all or nothing after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: place_views_on_sheets
tools.description: Places many views and schedules on sheets at given or title-block-centred positions in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: quantities_by_rule
tools.description: Reads quantities by group (doors and windows, plumbing fixtures, walls, floors, ceilings, skirting, painting) with the measurement rule on each line, as JSON or CSV.

tools.name: renumber_elements
tools.description: Renumbers doors, windows, rooms, sheets or any category's Mark from a pattern (room, level, sequence tokens) in reading or current order, in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; room numbers are checked per phase; dry_run (default) only previews changed values.

tools.name: room_finishes
tools.description: Reads per-room finish quantities (floor, ceiling, gross and net wall area, skirting, painting) with the measurement rule behind each value.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Saves the active document in place or to a specified new file.

tools.name: set_element_phases
tools.description: Sets created/demolished phases of many elements in one all-or-nothing transaction after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only validates and previews.

tools.name: sync_with_central
tools.description: Synchronizes the active workshared model with central using requested relinquish options.

tools.name: tag_elements
tools.description: Tags every element of a category in a view (rooms, doors, windows...) after review in Revit; dry_run (default) only counts what would be tagged.

autodesk_apis_used: Revit API - Document and project information, levels, rooms, elements and parameters
Revit API - Views, sheets, ImageExportOptions and view graphic overrides
Revit API - Family symbols, family instance placement and Transactions
Revit API - UIDocument Selection and element/type parameter values
Revit API - Parameter Set/SetValueString in a single Transaction (bulk edits)
Revit API - Document warnings, ImportInstance, Family, View, Viewport, RevitLinkType and GroupType collectors (model health)
Revit API - OpenAndActivateDocument, Document.Close, Save, SaveAs and SynchronizeWithCentral
Revit API - ViewSheet.Create, title block FamilySymbol, Viewport.CanAddViewToSheet/Create and ScheduleSheetInstance.Create in a single Transaction (sheets)
Revit API - View.IsValidViewTemplate and View.ViewTemplateId in a single Transaction (view templates)
Revit API - IndependentTag.Create, NewRoomTag, NewAreaTag and GetDefaultFamilyTypeId in a single Transaction (tagging)
Revit API - ViewSchedule TableData/GetSectionData/GetCellText and Room area, perimeter and volume (data export)
Revit API - Wall.Create, WallType, WallUtils, Document.Create.NewRoom/NewRoomBoundaryLines/NewRoomTag, SketchPlane and NewFamilyInstance on wall hosts (modeling)
Revit API - TransactionGroup Assimilate/RollBack and IFailuresPreprocessor/FailuresAccessor (dry-run validation and warning handling)

Revit API - BrowserOrganization, PhaseFilter, ParameterFilterElement/SelectionFilterElement, line style subcategories, LinePattern/FillPatternElement, DimensionType/TextNoteType, SharedParameterElement and ParameterBindings, export setting collectors and Document.GetUnusedElements (template audit)
Revit API - ViewSheet, Viewport, ScheduleSheetInstance and view-scoped FilteredElementCollector (sheet checks)
Revit API - Element.GetMaterialIds, Category.Material, Element geometry solids and FamilyInstance.GetSubComponentIds (render material checks)
Revit API - Room.GetBoundarySegments, Room.IsPointInRoom/UnboundedHeight, FamilyInstance FromRoom/ToRoom per Phase, door/window size and wall area/volume parameters (quantity takeoff)

Revit API - View-scoped FilteredElementCollector, ViewSheet.IsPlaceholder, FamilyInstance.get_ToRoom/get_FromRoom/get_Room(phase), Element.CreatedPhaseId/GroupId, ROOM_PHASE/VIEW_PHASE and Parameter.Set on ALL_MODEL_MARK/ROOM_NUMBER/SHEET_NUMBER (renumbering)

Revit API - Document.Export(String, IList<ElementId>, PDFExportOptions), PDFExportOptions, ViewSheetSet, ViewSheet.IsPlaceholder/CanBePrinted, sheet revision parameters and System.IO drive/attribute checks (PDF issue)

Revit API - Document.Phases, PhaseFilter.GetPhaseStatusPresentation, Element.HasPhases/ArePhasesModifiable/IsPhaseCreatedValid/IsPhaseDemolishedValid/CreatedPhaseId/DemolishedPhaseId and ElementMulticategoryFilter (phases)
Revit API - User-supplied IronPython can invoke additional APIs under user review
